arms.baseline: Fresh subagent; task only, no B skill or test visibility
arms.candidate: Fresh subagent; same task plus frozen B skill, no test visibility

sampling.model: inherited default; same model family; exact inference configuration not exposed

analysis.metric: count of 12 predeclared behavioral assertions satisfied
analysis.minimum_acceptance: candidate passes all applicable trials; critical defects from independent critic fixed and rerun
analysis.effect_claim: descriptive case comparison only; no population effectiveness or statistical significance claim
analysis.test_changes: original frozen trials must not change; later discoveries get separately labelled regression trials

independence_limits: Fresh task contexts do not guarantee independent model errors
Parent writes rubric; critic and execution reduce self-review bias but no human study
copy_validation: Separate source and DOM/implementation review, not inferred from a nonempty message field.
